rules.name: MERN Stack Best Practices
rules.description: Node.js and React development standards for Export Contract Generator

backend.architecture: MVC-style with routes, controllers, models, utilities
backend.validation: Validate on both frontend and backend
backend.security: Sanitize inputs, use CORS, environment variables

frontend.library: React 18.x with functional components and hooks
frontend.stateManagement: React Context for global state, local state for components
frontend.errorHandling: Display user-friendly messages, implement loading states

naming.files: camelCase for backend, PascalCase for React components
naming.variables: descriptive names, booleans start with is/has/should

database.schemas: Include validation, indexes, timestamps, pre-save hooks
database.queries: Use populate() for references, lean() for read-only, implement pagination
database.deletion: Prefer soft delete with isActive flag

apiDesign.responses: Consistent JSON format with proper HTTP status codes

mongooseModel.code: const schema = new mongoose.Schema({ field: { type: String, required: true, trim: true } }, { timestamps: true }); schema.index({ field: 1 });

expressController.description: Standard Express controller with error handling
expressController.code: exports.getResource = async (req, res) => { try { const resource = await Model.findById(req.params.id).populate('ref'); if (!resource) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Not found' }); res.json(resource); } catch (error) { console.error('Error:', error); res.status(500).json({ message: 'Server error' }); } };

reactComponent.description: Standard React functional component with hooks
reactComponent.code:

apiService.code: const apiClient = axios.create({ baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); export const resourceAPI = { getAll: (params) => apiClient.get('/resources', { params }), getById: (id) => apiClient.get(`/resources/${id}`), create: (data) => apiClient.post('/resources', data), update: (id, data) => apiClient.put(`/resources/${id}`, data), delete: (id) => apiClient.delete(`/resources/${id}`) };

newBackendFeature: Create Mongoose model with validation and indexes
Create controller with CRUD operations and error handling
Create routes and register in server.js
codeReview: All inputs validated on both frontend and backend
No sensitive data in code (use environment variables)

avoid: Hard delete without soft delete option

backend: Use indexes on frequently queried fields
Select only needed fields with populate()

required: Validate data on both frontend and backend
Use environment variables for sensitive data

rules.name: Project-Specific Patterns
rules.description: Patterns specific to Export Contract Generator

calculations.numberToText: Use number-to-words library with currency formatting

softDelete.pattern: Use isActive: false instead of removing records
softDelete.query: Always filter by isActive: true for active records

references.populate: Always populate references when returning contract details

testing.coverage: Test all CRUD operations and edge cases
